message.jaymospowers.armour_oil.oiled: You oil %s pieces of armour. They'll stay bright for three days.
jei.jaymospowers.straw_wisp: Stand in water (or at a water cauldron), sneak and use it to scrub blood and dirt off yourself and your armour, rotten blood too. Hold something in your other hand to scrub that instead. A handful of sand does the same, used up each scrub. Nothing takes rust off.
